description: This file defines a PHP class representing the XHTML 1.1 Target Module for the HTML Purifier library. It specifies how the 'target' attribute is added to 'a' elements within the HTML purification process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Target
classes.description: A module for handling the 'target' attribute in 'a' elements for XHTML 1.1 in the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the module by adding a 'target' attribute to 'a' elements, utilizing the 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_FrameTarget' attribute definition.
